environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an AWS NLB (Network Load Balancer) with TLS passthrough. No request inspection or schema validation at the network layer. Clients connect directly via HTTPS to the NLB which forwards TCP to the container on port 8000. No API gateway or request filtering in the path.

config.network: Public subnet, security group allows 443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0
